needs_human.note: _ReadResult.frame_gap is computed but never used (R3).; _collect_incomplete's SQL selects every outdated native video under any mode, including manual and false. These rows pass through the inapplicable-flag loop on each resume and are filtered only in the Python queueing loop.; _frame_ocr_worker performs an extra DB lookup per frame task before running it (R2).; run.sh pipes every harness output through `grep -v -i warn`, which also removes DIFF lines from i2_check whose recognised text contains 'warn'. run.sh also discards i2_check's exit status with `|| true`.

_ReadResult.frame_gap is computed on every decoded frame and never read (frame_ocr.py:126,404).; If the _is_outdated_frame_read lookup raises in _frame_ocr_worker (indexer.py:2014-2016), the frame task is dropped without running index_frame_ocr.
